title: TrackMan Shot Ball Speed Leaderboard
dataSources: Bar-velocity reps (`vbt:rep`), running gait (`gait:metric`), hangboard sessions (`hangboard:session`), golf-swing metrics (`golfswing:metric`), power-meter intervals (`powermeter:interval`), basketball shot arcs (`shotarc:make`).
app: Sports and skill sensors — velocity-based-training bar trackers, running-form IMUs, climbing hangboard load cells, golf launch monitors, cycling power meters, and computer-vision shot trackers — logged to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trackman:shot ball_speed_mph=*
| stats sum(ball_speed_mph) as total_value, avg(ball_speed_mph) as avg_value by club
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks club values by total and average ball speed across TrackMan shot events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `ball_speed_mph` values for each TrackMan shot event and review total and average ball speed by club.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total ball speed.
grandmaExplanation: It compares your which club shows the biggest ball speed numbers in your TrackMan shot data.
